observations.representation: final normalized CLS,768D per independently encoded physical crop
observations.missing: exact retain; no row exclusion, alternate source, alternate time or fabricated feature

architecture.projection: train-population-only deterministic full-SVD PCA48 plus train-only scaler
architecture.head: 48weights+1bias posture offset
architecture.training: continuous bounded delta; fixed class-weighted three-class NLL plus0.01L2; L-BFGS-B maxiter500
architecture.inference: exact retain if missing or abs(delta)<=0.25; otherwise posture-only
architecture.selection: none; source, region, cap, deadzone, penalty and optimizer are fixed prospectively

ancestry.topology: fixed recipe, three scenario blocks, no additional learned policy-selection layer
ancestry.training_prior: row in block B receives full historical F(T-minus-B)
ancestry.outer_prior: full historical F(T), exact parity with retained ARFTR required

preflight.selection: first16 IDs in existing128 label-blind pilot order
preflight.accuracy_gate: none; this is mechanics and resource measurement

stopping: A failed fixed primary closes this source/crop/head/policy recipe; no post-hoc arm, threshold, width or seed rescue.
long_job_rule: Do not launch any training job projected above1200seconds; prepare command/run directory and hand off after bounded startup.
